, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the confirmed death dates—Edwin L. Marin (1951) vs. Maurice Elvey (1967)—and incorrectly concluded that The Death Kiss’s director died later. This is a logical inversion error; Elvey (Her Luck in London) died later, so the correct film is Her Luck in London.
